# Diff Fixture

*A tree built to exercise every diff class at once: one law unchanged, one
amended on enforced-by only (PATCH), one amended on severity (MAJOR), one
law the index knows that the tree repealed (MAJOR), and one law the tree
added (MINOR).*

**Version:** 1.0.0 · **Status:** fixture

The index under dist/ was written by hand to describe the previous state.
